retry_policy.rule: Every scheduled slot produces at most one attempt. Infrastructure, budget, implementation, human, integrity, timeout and verifier outcomes remain visible in the cohort. Do not reroll a failed slot.

ordering_policy.reason: Avoid always assigning one lane the first or last temporal position while keeping the complete schedule preregistered and reproducible.

preregistration.timing: committed before suite/task eligibility and before any scored B0 trial
preregistration.rationale: B0 is a harness-integrity milestone with one narrow admitted task. Three independent scheduled attempts per lane are the minimum useful cohort for a median/range and stochastic-repeat demonstration without turning #102 into a high-cost benchmark program. Larger publishable suites belong to later B1/B2 growth.
